title: Meet-Up at 17:15, Whistle at 18:00: Kiosk Shows Both | vitalii.no
description:
Spond tells parents two different times for the same game: the meet-up time everyone actually plans around, and the kickoff itself. Our kiosk only ever showed the kickoff time, copied straight from Spond's own start field — so a kid told to arrive fifteen minutes early walked in exactly on time for the whistle and still looked late.

The calendar server now reports the meet-up time as the event's start time, and carries the kickoff separately. A new helper in the kiosk's calendar strip compares the two: when they differ by five minutes or more it prints both, like '17:15 to 18:00'; anything closer just prints one time, so a short training meet-up doesn't turn into visual noise.

Both the compact ribbon and the two-day agenda view on the kiosk now use this same logic, so a kid glancing at the TV on the way out the door sees exactly when to actually be at the venue — 17:15, not just the 18:00 whistle.
